question: An administrator wants to enable a VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC to interoperate with an on-premises SDDC. How this is achieved? A. Use the SDDC console to configure the IPSEC VPN connection between the VMware Cloud on AWS and on-premises vSphere SDDC. B. Specify the static IP address of the on-premises SDDC when initially requesting a new VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC. C. Use the AWS management Console to configure the connection between the VMware Cloud on AWS and on-premises vSphere SDDC. D. Specify the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the on-premises SDDC when initially requesting a new VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC.

How can an administrator manage permissions in a VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC? A. access the vSphere client create custom roles in VMware Cloud on AWS B. associate predefined roles in the SDDC console with workload objects in a VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC C. configure Hybrid Linked Mode and assign permissions to on-premises users and groups D. use the SDDC console to group permissions into custom roles in VMware Cloud on AWS

Which two actions should an administrator take before removing a vSphere cluster from a vCenter running on VMware Cloud on AWS? (Choose two.) A. Disconnect all hosts in the cluster. B. Power off all workload VMs. C. Power off all hosts in the cluster. D. Make a copy of any data to be kept. E. Migrate any workload VMs to be retained to another cluster.
Which VMware Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) tool is used for bulk workload migrations? A. VMware Secure Networking B. VMware Cross-Cloud Services C. VMware NSX Cloud D. VMware NSX Hybrid Connect
Which pricing model is available for VMware Cloud on AWS? A. pay per user B. licensing by version family C. number of VMs D. on-demand subscription

What can happen when ESXi host in a VMware Cloud on AWS cluster fails? A. A new host is added to the cluster, and data from problem host is rebuilt or migrated on the new host. B. VMware Site Recovery initiates a failover of the host. C. A new host is failed over to another availability zone. D. Administrators are notified to add a new host to the cluster and to run the reprotect workflow.

What are two ways to import VM templates to a library in VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC? (Choose two.) A. Configure Hybrid Linked Mode. B. Initiate the failback feature of the VMware Site Recovery Manager Add-On. C. Install VMware vRealize Automation on the VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC. D. Use the Content Onboarding Assistant. E. Subscribe to an on-premises Content Library.

An SDDC in VMware Cloud on AWS can interoperate with how many other SDDCs? A. with one on-premises vSphere SDDC or one other VMware Cloud on AWS SDDC B. with any number of on-premises vSphere SDDC C. only with a single on-premises vSphere SDDC D. with a single on-premises vSphere SDDC plus any number of VMware Cloud on AWS SDDCs
Which API endpoint is used to manage an SDDC in a VMware Cloud on AWS instance? A. VMware vSphere API B. VMware Deployed SDDC API C. VMware Cloud on AWS API D. Cloud Service Platform API

An administrator wants to run network connectivity tests to ensure that all necessary relevant access is available for using Hybrid Linked Mode. Which tab on the View Details page for the SDDC would the administrator use to run the test? A. Troubleshooting B. Settings C. Network D. Add Ons

What is an advantage of using AWS CloudFormation change sets? A. greater confidence in managing AWS resource stacks B. control of the power-on sequence of VMs in an SDDC in VMware Cloud on AWS C. version control of applications installed on VMs D. better management of application configurations deployed in an SDDC in VMware Cloud on AWS
Which network includes the vCenter Server and VMware NSX Manager? A. management gateway B. compute gateway C. transit logical switch D. workload network
